component.name: pgpEncrypt
component.description: Encrypt the input for a recipient using their PGP public key.

component.name: pgpDecrypt
component.description: Decrypt the input using your PGP private key and passphrase.

component.name: pgpSign
component.description: Sign the input with your PGP private key.

component.name: pgpVerify
component.description: Verify a signed message with the sender's PGP public key.

component.name: pgpSignAndEncrypt
component.description: Sign with your private key, then encrypt for the recipient (outbound).

component.name: pgpDecryptAndVerify
component.description: Decrypt with your private key, then verify the sender's signature (inbound).
